_note: An attachment on a component is a prop keyed by a fresh symbol (svelte2tsx writes `[Symbol("@attach")]: fn` into the component's props), so the component's symbol index signature gives the arrow's parameter its type: `element` is an HTMLDivElement here, and the only error is the missing property on it. Written as a spread (`...(fn)`) the arrow has no contextual type, so both parameters were implicitly `any` (TS7006) and the property error went unreported.
